company: Google LLC (Google Cloud Platform), a subsidiary of Alphabet Inc.

ownership.quote: Google Cloud Platform (Compute Engine) is a product of Google LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of Alphabet Inc., a publicly traded company (NASDAQ: GOOGL/GOOG).

stage.quote: Alphabet Inc. is listed on NASDAQ under GOOGL and GOOG.
stage.note: Google Compute Engine is a product line within Google Cloud, a segment of publicly traded Alphabet Inc.; not independently funded.

revenue.basis: Alphabet Inc. consolidated full-year 2024 revenue as reported in its 10-K/earnings release; Google Cloud segment (which includes Compute Engine) reported revenue of approximately $43.2 billion within this total. Figure is for the whole of Alphabet, not Compute Engine specifically.
revenue.quote: Alphabet Inc. reported total revenues of $350.0 billion for the full year 2024, with Google Cloud revenues of $43.2 billion.

note: Google Compute Engine (GCE) is a product of Google Cloud Platform, itself a segment of Alphabet Inc., a public company (NASDAQ: GOOGL). It is not independently funded and has no separate funding history, accelerator participation, or standalone revenue disclosure; only Alphabet-wide and Google Cloud segment revenue are publicly reported.
